chat.sp.jack.intro:
Happy Halloween!
I am Jack, the Czar of Halloween!
Tonight is a very special, spooky night...
Let's make it frightfully fun!
chat.sp.jack.ask:
Now then... trick or treat!
No candy, and you'll get a trick!
chat.sp.jack.thanks:
Ooh! Candy!
The sweetest joy of Halloween! Thank you!
chat.sp.jack.trick:
What... nothing at all?
Then it's a trick! Heh heh heh...!
chat.sp.jack.0: The sweetness of candy is tonight's magic...
chat.sp.jack.1: Dressing up as a ghost is half the fun of Halloween!
chat.sp.jack.2: The pumpkin lanterns are glowing just right.
chat.sp.daisy-mae.2: I only come on Sunday mornings!
chat.sp.daisy-mae.3: Good morning! What a nice day!
chat.sp.wisp.1: The island's so quiet at night…
chat.sp.gulliver.1: I seem to have fallen off my ship…
chat.sp.gulliver.3: My crew should come get me soon!
chat.sp.kicks.intro:
Hey there, I'm Kicks.
I run a shoe and bag shop
on islands all over.
Just saying hi today, though.
chat.sp.kicks.1: Good shoes put a spring in your step.
chat.sp.kicks.2: Well-walked shoes are the coolest kind.
chat.sp.kicks.3: You look light on your feet today!
chat.sp.label.intro:
Hello! I'm Label!
I'm touring the islands
looking for ideas
for new fashion!
chat.sp.label.0: Clothes you can move in are the best!
chat.sp.label.2: A smile after a workout is the best accessory.
chat.sp.label.3: I'd love to use this island's colours in a design.
chat.sp.saharah.intro:
Hoo hoo… I am Saharah.
I come from a faraway desert,
travelling in search
of wondrous rugs.
chat.sp.saharah.0: An island that doesn't smell of sand…
chat.sp.saharah.1: A room's floor is so very important.
chat.sp.saharah.3: My journey goes on and on…
chat.sp.leif.intro:
Heyyy… I'm Leif.
I really love growing
flowers and trees.
Your island's so green, duuude.
chat.sp.leif.1: Growing slowly is cool too, dude.
chat.sp.leif.2: The smell of soil is so relaxing…
chat.sp.leif.3: Bodies are like trees: a little every day.
chat.sp.redd.intro:
Hey, cousin! Name's Redd.
I tour the islands
with rare treasures…
today I'm just scoping things out.
chat.sp.redd.0: Shh… this stays between us, cousin.
chat.sp.redd.1: Real or fake? It takes a good eye.
chat.sp.redd.2: Nice island you got here, cousin.
chat.sp.cj.intro:
Hey! C.J. here!
I make videos
showing off my fishing.
Can't wait to see the fish here!
chat.sp.cj.1: Fishing is all patience and guts!
chat.sp.cj.2: Tell me if you land a big one!
chat.sp.flick.intro:
…Hey. I'm Flick.
I make art
inspired by bugs.
Came to see this island's bugs.
chat.sp.flick.0: A bug's shape is… art, you know?
chat.sp.flick.3: Tell me if you find a rare one.
chat.sp.daisy-mae.intro:
Morning! I'm Daisy Mae!
I sell Grandma's turnips.
Just saying hi today…
See you next Sunday morning!
chat.sp.wisp.intro:
Boo! …Did I scare you?
I'm Wisp. I'm a ghost.
Please don't be scared…
I just love night walks.
chat.sp.reese.intro:
Hello! I'm Reese.
This is my husband, Cyrus.
We came to cheer you on
for your wedding!
chat.sp.reese.day:
Congratulations on your wedding!
Have a wonderful day!
chat.sp.reese.0:
How are the wedding
plans coming along?
chat.sp.reese.1:
Your two smiles are
just lovely.
chat.sp.reese.2:
Staying healthy every day is
the best gift of all!
chat.sp.reese.3:
We're looking forward
to the big day too!
chat.sp.cyrus.1:
I was nervous on
my wedding day too.
chat.sp.cyrus.2:
Seeing Reese this happy
makes my day.
chat.sp.cyrus.3:
Take care of each other,
you hear?
chat.sp.franklin.intro:
Happy Turkey Day!
I'm Franklin, the chef.
Today's the day we all sit down
to a big feast together!
chat.sp.franklin.ask:
For my very best dish
I need one fish.
If you catch one, would you
bring it to me?
chat.sp.franklin.thanks:
Oh! A splendid {fish}!
Thank you! Now I can make
the finest feast of all!
chat.sp.franklin.0:
Smells good, doesn't it?
Almost ready!
chat.sp.franklin.1:
Food in season
gives you energy!
chat.sp.franklin.2:
Your fish is going to
taste wonderful!
chat.sp.franklin.vegAsk:
And for the side dish,
I'd love {name} too!
Could you spare one?
chat.sp.franklin.vegThanks:
Oh! A fresh {name}!
Perfect for the side dish!
Here's {v} shells for you.
chat.sp.jingle.intro:
Merry Toy Day!
I'm Jingle!
Tonight's the special night
I deliver presents!
chat.sp.jingle.1:
It's cold out, so stay
warm when you sleep!
chat.sp.jingle.3:
Ho ho! Have a
jolly Toy Day!
chat.sp.zipper.intro:
Hoppy hop!
I'm Zipper!
Let's hunt for
Bunny Day eggs!
chat.sp.zipper.0:
Eggs hide in the ground
and on balloons, hop!
chat.sp.zipper.1:
You might even fish
one up, hop!
chat.sp.zipper.3:
Hop hop! Let's keep
bouncing along!
chat.sp.celeste.intro:
Oh, good evening!
I'm Celeste. I just love the stars.
There'll be lots of shooting stars tonight!
Let's watch them together.
chat.sp.celeste.0:
When you see a shooting star,
tap the sky and make a wish!
chat.sp.celeste.1:
Wish on one, and tomorrow morning
star fragments wash up on the beach.
chat.sp.celeste.2:
This season's sign is {sign}.
You might find its fragment too!
chat.sp.celeste.3:
Hoo! Did you see that one?
What a lovely shooting star!
chat.sp.gulliver.intro:
…Mmmh… Huh!
What island is this?
I seem to have fallen off my ship…
I'll wait here for my crew.
chat.sp.kk-slider.hello:
Hey, thanks for coming out tonight.
Got a request?
chat.sp.kk-slider.tuning:
Just tuning my guitar right now…
Give me a little while.
chat.sp.kk-slider.dayHello:
Hey. Just noodling around.
Want to hear one?
chat.sp.kk-slider.asleep:
…Mmm… show's over for tonight…
Catch you tomorrow…
chat.sp.kk-slider.wake:
…Hm…? Mmm… a request?
*yawn*… Sure, I'll play you one.
chat.sp.gracie.intro:
Oh, hello, darling!
I'm Gracie.
I've brought some of my
finest furniture today.
chat.sp.gracie.offer: Care to see the pieces I chose?
chat.sp.wardell.intro:
Hey, I'm Wardell!
I've brought all kinds of
furniture for your rooms.
chat.sp.wardell.0: One piece can change a whole room.
chat.sp.wardell.1: A happy client is the best reward.
chat.sp.wardell.3: I'll bring more pieces next time.
chat.sp.katrina.intro:
Welcome…
I am Katrina.
Let me read your
fortune for today…
chat.sp.katrina.1: I hear the voices of the stars…
chat.sp.katrina.3: Come back tomorrow for another reading.
chat.sp.wendell.intro:
Ugh… oh…
I'm so hungry…
I can't move…
A fish… please…
chat.sp.wendell.ask:
Just one fish…
Could you catch me one…?
chat.sp.wendell.thanks:
Delicious! I feel alive again!
As thanks, please take
this {item}!
chat.sp.wendell.1: The waves carried me all the way here.
chat.sp.wendell.2: The fish on this island are tasty.
chat.sp.wendell.3: I'll come back when I'm hungry again.
chat.sp.gullivarrr.intro:
Yo ho ho!
I be a pirate!
Fell off me ship and
washed up here, arrr!
chat.sp.gullivarrr.2: The treasure here be yer smiles!
chat.sp.gullivarrr.3: Yo ho! A fine wind today!
chat.sp.pete.intro:
Mail call!
I'm Pete.
I've got a delivery
for you!
chat.sp.pete.given:
Delivery done!
See you next time.
chat.sp.leilani.intro:
Aloha!
I'm Leilani.
I've brought presents
for everyone!
chat.sp.leilani.1: Like the breeze of a southern island.
chat.sp.leilani.2: A smile is the best gift.
chat.sp.lottie.intro:
Hi there!
I'm Lottie.
I help people make
their rooms lovely.
chat.sp.lottie.gift:
This is for your room:
a {item}!
chat.sp.lottie.given: Did you put it in a room?
chat.sp.lottie.0: A room should feel like you.
chat.sp.lottie.3: I'll bring more ideas next time.
chat.sp.chip.intro:
Hey! I'm Chip.
Show me your
fishing skills!
chat.sp.nat.intro:
Hello, I'm Nat.
I've come to see
your bug-catching skills.
chat.sp.nat.0: Watch closely, then creep up gently.
chat.sp.nat.2: I'm hoping for a rare one.
chat.sp.rover.intro:
Hi, nice to meet you!
I'm on a trip and
thought I'd stop by.
chat.sp.rover.1: Travel is one meeting after another.
chat.sp.shrunk.intro:
Howdy, I'm Dr. Shrunk!
I've come to deliver
some laughs today.
chat.sp.shrunk.1: Come on, give me a smile.
chat.sp.tortimer.intro:
Ho ho ho…
I'm Tortimer.
I was an island's mayor,
long ago.
chat.sp.tortimer.0: Young folks are so full of energy.
chat.sp.tortimer.1: Island life is best taken slowly.
chat.sp.tortimer.2: Ho ho, a fine island indeed.
chat.sp.phineas.intro:
Buongiorno!
I'm Phineas.
I've come to cheer on
the hard workers!
chat.sp.phineas.1: I'd give you both a badge.
chat.sp.pave.intro:
Festivale!
I'm Pavé!
Today we dance and dance
and dance!
chat.sp.pave.2: A festival is a feast for the heart.
chat.sp.resetti.reset:
Wh-what?! A RESET?!
You sure about this?!
chat.sp.copper.wrong:
Halt! That key won't
get you through, sir!
chat.sp.booker.wait:
I'm checking, sir…
please wait a moment…
